model_architecture:
EncoderDecoderTransformer(
  (enc_layers): ModuleList(
    (0-5): 6 x SelfAttentionEncoderLayer(
      (self_attn): SelfAttentionLayer(
        (mha): MultiheadAttention(
          (out_proj): NonDynamicallyQuantizableLinear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=True)
        )
        (norm): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
        (dropout): Dropout(p=0.1, inplace=False)
      )
      (ffn): FeedForwardLayer(
        (ffn): Sequential(
          (0): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=1024, bias=True)
          (1): GELU(approximate='none')
          (2): Dropout(p=0.1, inplace=False)
          (3): Linear(in_features=1024, out_features=256, bias=True)
        )
        (norm): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
        (dropout): Dropout(p=0.1, inplace=False)
      )
    )
  )
  (dec_layers): ModuleList(
    (0-5): 6 x CrossAttentionDecoderLayer(
      (self_attn): SelfAttentionLayer(
        (mha): MultiheadAttention(
          (out_proj): NonDynamicallyQuantizableLinear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=True)
        )
        (norm): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
        (dropout): Dropout(p=0.1, inplace=False)
      )
      (cross_attn): CrossAttentionLayer(
        (mha): MultiheadAttention(
          (out_proj): NonDynamicallyQuantizableLinear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=True)
        )
        (norm): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
        (dropout): Dropout(p=0.1, inplace=False)
      )
      (ffn): FeedForwardLayer(
        (ffn): Sequential(
          (0): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=1024, bias=True)
          (1): GELU(approximate='none')
          (2): Dropout(p=0.1, inplace=False)
          (3): Linear(in_features=1024, out_features=256, bias=True)
        )
        (norm): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
        (dropout): Dropout(p=0.1, inplace=False)
      )
    )
  )
  (source_embedding): SpeechEmbedding(
    (cnn): Conv2DSubsampling(
      (conv): Sequential(
        (0): Conv2d(1, 256, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(2, 1))
        (1): GELU(approximate='none')
        (2): Conv2d(256, 256, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(1, 1))
        (3): GELU(approximate='none')
      )
      (linear_out): Linear(in_features=19456, out_features=256, bias=True)
      (dropout): Dropout(p=0.1, inplace=False)
    )
    (blstm): StackedBLSTMEmbedding(
      (blstm1): LSTM(256, 128, batch_first=True, bidirectional=True)
      (blstm2): LSTM(256, 128, batch_first=True, bidirectional=True)
      (pool1): MaxPool1d(kernel_size=2, stride=2, padding=0, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False)
      (pool2): MaxPool1d(kernel_size=1, stride=1, padding=0, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False)
      (linear_embed): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=True)
      (dropout): Dropout(p=0.1, inplace=False)
    )
  )
  (target_embedding): Embedding(35, 256)
  (positional_encoding): PositionalEncoding()
  (final_linear): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=35, bias=True)
  (dropout): Dropout(p=0.1, inplace=False)
  (encoder_norm): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
  (decoder_norm): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
  (ctc_head): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=35, bias=True)
    (1): LogSoftmax(dim=-1)
  )
)
